title: Freiburg — City Trees
description: 45,413 registered public trees reveal Freiburg’s planting patterns, coloured by botanical genus against a subtle street network.

title: Germany’s Traffic Intensity
description: Germany’s motorways and major roads glow in seven classes of modelled daily vehicle traffic, revealing the busiest estimated corridors.

title: Munich — Cadastral Mosaic
description: 29,601 cadastral footprints form a colourful portrait of central Munich, with the Isar and parks in cream.

title: Logistics clusters across Spain
description: 25,249 OpenStreetMap storage and logistics objects form a luminous density map of mainland Spain, with subtle motorway and trunk-road context.

title: HOW FAR CAN YOU SEE?
description: 8,833 calculated viewpoints reveal potential visible space across Barcelona’s Eixample, with mint and gold openings against a dark street grid.

title: MAR OCÉANO
description: 45,303 screened links between recorded CLIWOC ship-log positions trace a surviving sample of Atlantic movement, 1750–1850.

title: Share of Population Aged 15–29
description: A simple municipal choropleth maps the share of residents aged 15–29 across peninsular Spain and Mallorca, using 2025 INE population data.

title: Where Spain Grows and Shrinks
description: A municipal choropleth maps percentage population change across Spain from 2010 to 2025, with large municipalities outlined for context.

title: Tenochtitlan 1519 — Expanded Canal Network
description: A prompt-led visual interpretation of Tenochtitlan, with an illustrated island core, causeways and expanded canal network.

title: The Sound of Freiburg
description: Official 2022 road traffic noise contours reveal Freiburg’s louder corridors, with parks, woodland and water shown as context for relative quiet.
